title: Pin tile into a tilted dark panel tour
summary: A warning card on a tilted plane yields to a white pin that settles into an app tile; glowing pills draw in, tilted UI panels pass under rack focus, then a two-line close and a flat wordmark.
use_when: A privacy, security or utility product whose story is: you are exposed, here is the switch
Silent autoplay launch where dark tilted UI and soft glow carry the premium feel
A small UI with 3-5 distinct panels that read well leaned back in 3D
The app icon is a strong single glyph that can stand alone for 4 s

look.type_style: medium grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking; UI labels 2-3 % H on tilted panels, close statement 4.5 % H bold, second line grey; wordmark 5 % H with a pin glyph

sfx.event: pin tile lands behind the glyph
each city pill outline closes and lights
hard cut to a new tilted panel
map card unfolds under the toggles

structure.shot: dark card on a plane tilted back: bold warning headline, 6 words, over a 4-line body; a white pin rises from behind its top edge
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateX ~25 deg; plane drifts down ~70 px/s @1920 and grows 0.8-1.9 %/s; card blurs out after 3.50
structure.motion: body words light from grey to white left to right, ~1.1 s per line (±0.25 s); pin rises from 1.00 on springs.heavy ~75 fr, enters sharp at 3.00 (rack-focus card -> pin, 18 fr)

structure.shot: white map pin with a dark shield cut-out alone in centre; blurred card sinks below frame
structure.camera: pull-out: pin scale 1.00 -> 0.80 over 66 fr, easings.inOutSine
structure.motion: card slides down and out, blur 0 -> 14 px, easings.inExpo 60 fr (±0.25 s); pin holds sharp

structure.shot: a rounded dark-grey app tile grows behind the pin, making the full app icon; holds centred
structure.motion: tile scales 0.6 -> 1.0 from behind the pin, springs.ui 15 fr, opacity 0 -> 1 over 10 fr; holds 1.4 s

structure.shot: black; thin elbow connector lines draw down, each ends in a glowing rounded pill that lights with a red dot, coordinates and a city name; 3 of 6 pills
structure.camera: near static: slow pull-out -1.1 %/s with drift right ~10 px/s @1920, easings.linear
structure.motion: per pill: line draws 6 fr easings.outQuint, outline closes 8 fr, label fades in 6 fr; pills start every ~13 fr (8.20, 8.87, 9.33)

structure.shot: same field: pills 4-6 draw in the lower right and top right; all six hold, outlines glowing
structure.motion: same pill draw, starts 10.00, 10.50, 11.00 (stagger 15 fr); full set holds 0.73 s

structure.shot: the pill field jumps to a steep tilted plane, close and large; nearest pill sharp, far pills soft
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateX ~45 deg, rotateZ -15 deg; dolly left ~90 px/s @1920 with push-in +14 %/s, easings.linear
structure.motion: no element motion; depth of field blur grows with distance (maxBlur ~6 px)

structure.shot: dolly continues: the nearest pill slides out left, the far pills come to the centre
structure.motion: nearest pill exits frame left at ~16.00

structure.shot: pin glyph and wordmark on a tilted dark slab, letters glowing softly
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateZ -8 deg, pull-out -6 %/s, slight drift down
structure.motion: glow on letters breathes 0.6 -> 1.0 over 30 fr (±0.25 s); no entrance, the cut is the reveal

structure.shot: close tilted settings card: two protection rows with icons and green on-toggles; wordmark header slides in blurred above
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateZ -15 deg; pull-out -6 %/s, pan up ~190 px/s @1920 at 18.50-19.25
structure.motion: header enters from top under blur (rack-focus 18 fr, ±0.25 s); toggles already on, no state change

structure.shot: the whole panel frontal on a back-tilted plane: header, two toggles, a map card unfolds below, then a location row with coordinates
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateX ~30 deg, slow pull-out -2.6 %/s and drift up ~25 px/s @1920
structure.motion: map card height 0 -> full over 22 fr from 20.77 (springs.layout, overshoot not measurable); location row fades in 8 fr at 21.50; rest of panel soft at the edges

structure.shot: city picker on a steep tilted plane: search field, heading, 5 city rows with flags, one row checked
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateX ~40 deg, rotateZ 15 deg; push-in +12.5 %/s, list drifts up ~90 px/s @1920
structure.motion: rows hold; far rows lose focus (depth of field); no row animation

structure.shot: edge of a phone with a segmented 3-tab control and an allowed-sites list of 3 rows
structure.camera: tilt-plane rotateZ ~25 deg; push-in +17 %/s with drift left ~25 px/s @1920
structure.motion: middle tab already selected; list holds, blur on the near phone edge

structure.shot: flat black: centred bold line, 5 words, restating the problem; at 30.27 a grey second line, 5 words, offers the fix
structure.motion: line 1 blur-in, whole line, blur 8 px -> 0 and opacity 0.3 -> 1, easings.outExpo 12 fr; line 2 same entrance at 30.27 while line 1 moves up half a line, springs.ui 10 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: flat black: pin glyph and wordmark centred, white, small (5 % H)
structure.motion: appears on one frame after 1 empty frame; holds 83 fr

params.content.warning: card headline, 4-7 words, names the exposure; body 3-4 lines that light word by word
params.content.glyph: single white glyph that becomes the app icon (SVG)
params.content.places: 6 pill labels with a short meta line each (coordinates, ids)
params.content.panels: 3-4 UI panels to rebuild: toggle card, map/visual card, picker list, allow list
params.content.close: two lines: the problem in 5 words, the fix in 5 words (grey)
params.content.name: wordmark for the tilted slab and the final hold
params.timing.panelHold: frames per tilted panel shot (default 60, 118 for the map unfold)
params.glow: outline glow on pills and wordmark letters, 0-1 (default 0.6)

notes: No cuts detected by cuts.json; rows come from state changes and from 30 fps strips at 8, 12, 16, 18, 20, 24, 26, 28 and 32 s (cut times to 1 fr: 8.10, 12.23, 16.27, 18.27, 20.27, 24.20, 26.17, 28.20, 32.13). Panel shots run a near-regular 2 s period (60 fr) except the map unfold (118 fr). Accent colours the palettegen pass misses: red dots in the pills and green toggles; pick from the brand. Pill outlines carry a slight chromatic fringe. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms (not used as ids): read-along-light, connector-pill-draw, tile-behind-glyph, card-unfold.
